properties.title: Seven missing after tanker catches fire off Romanian coast
properties.description: Seven crew members are missing after a tanker caught fire close to Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea Thursday morning, Romanian authorities said. The San Marino-flagged chemical tanker sent a distress call at 7 a.m. local time about 13 nautical miles from Sulina, a port on Romania’s eastern coast, close to the Ukrainian border. Romanian border police, along with aviation units, arrived to assist the crew, the Romanian Naval Authority said . Five people have been rescued so far, the naval authority told local media . Another tanker was affected by a fire late on Wednesday close to Sulina, with authorities confirming the crew were safe. Romanian authorities have not given a reason for either incident. properties.title: Ukraine had ‘no warning’ of latest Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv
properties.description: KYIV — Russia caught the Ukrainian capital off guard with its latest attack, hitting the country with over 100 drones and five ballistic missiles, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday. “Intelligence on Russian ballistic missile launches helps save lives, and this is one of the most critical issues. This is precisely what helps prevent people from being killed — when there is an early warning about ballistic missiles,” Zelenskyy said . He added: “Regarding this strike, unfortunately, there was no warning from partners.” Kyiv usually receives a tip-off about impending Russian missiles via the Battlespace Command and Control Center system , which is operated and controlled by the United States’ military and NATO members, among others.
